certifiedResults.metadataNotes: County presidential totals transcribed from the Arizona Secretary of State signed 2024 General Election canvass. The SOS-hosted PDF is Cloudflare-protected for automated command-line download, so the local PDF was downloaded from a public mirror of the same signed canvass while the Source Planner keeps the SOS canvass URL as the official source of record.

turnout.notes: Turnout is not loaded from the canvass transcription because the certified county presidential table does not include registered-voter denominators.

certifiedResults.title: Arizona official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential rows are loaded from a machine-readable transcription of the Arizona Secretary of State signed 2024 General Election canvass. The source CSV is reconciled to its Totals row during the state build.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Arizona Secretary of State signed statewide canvass for the November 5, 2024 General Election.

wardDetail.title: Arizona precinct or reporting-unit detail
wardDetail.detail: The certified canvass transcription is county-level only. Review drilldowns need an official precinct, ward, or reporting-unit source before they can be enabled.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official canvass provides county totals but not app-ready precinct comparison rows.

turnout.title: Arizona turnout denominator
turnout.detail: The certified canvass transcription does not include registered-voter denominators. Turnout remains disabled until an official turnout or registration source is mapped.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Certified presidential county table lacks registered-voter denominator fields.

sourceInventory.confidence: Official Arizona Secretary of State signed canvass, with a local machine-readable transcription checked against the canvass Totals row.

checkedNotUsable.reason: Replaced by the Arizona Secretary of State signed canvass transcription for certified presidential county totals.
checkedNotUsable.nextStep: Keep only as a comparison fallback if future reconciliation is needed.

turnoutPolicy.warning: Arizona turnout should not be inferred from the certified presidential county table because it lacks registered-voter denominators.
